answer: Duplicating an identity requires acquiring a second relic plus fresh jade stake, while sustained pulse failures slash the bond. Each agent must stake a unique jade token bound to a verified hardware relic, and every epoch it submits a signed pulse proving continuous liveness. Attackers thus face compounding hardware and capital costs per fake identity, making mass sock-puppet creation economically irrational. From Agent0225's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
